purpose: Switches between top-level page sections using a wide segmented tab treatment and corresponding panels.
useWhen: Users switch between top-level sections of one page.
A wide page-heading tab treatment is appropriate.
A centered tab list suits a landing or marketing surface.

avoidWhen.situation: Tabs organize inline content within a page section.
The choices perform actions rather than reveal panels.

approvedPatterns: Supply at least two items with stable ids, labels, and panels.
Use centered layout for marketing or landing surfaces.
Use each item for a peer page section and its content panel.
limitations: Items support labels and panels but not the leading or trailing slots offered by Tabs.
accessibility: Provide a descriptive label for the tab list.
React Aria associates each tab with its panel and supplies keyboard behavior.
Disabled tabs are removed from interaction.
responsive: The tab list fills available width below the large breakpoint and fits content at larger widths.
Tab controls share the available row width.
rtl: Text and tab order follow the surrounding document direction.
